scurve._comment: Second page: the weightage S-curve from the JUI02 P6 master schedule. Its token is found under tokenKey (secret VL_TOKEN_JUI02_P6, or tokens.json "JUI02-P6").
scurve.title: JUI02 P6 master schedule

workforce._comment: Workforce page: VisiLean's type=workForce feed for this same project (the JUI02 quantity tracker), using its own token (secret VL_TOKEN_JUI02, or tokens.json "JUI02").
workforce.title: JUI02 daily labour report

display._subtradeColumn: JUI02 has no Subtrade custom field: the task's VisiLean trade is used in its place, and the page calls it Trade
display._progressExclude: Subtrade progress by location: subtrades matching this regular expression (case-insensitive) get no card
display._location: JUI02 locations read 'DC Building - DC4A' / 'HSD Yard - H1': building tokens via the shared tokenRules, everything else split on ' - '

scurve._weightField: The JUI02 P6 feed has no weightage or S-curve group custom field yet (only 'Construction Phase' and 'Critical Activity'); set these once they exist in VisiLean
scurve._defaultWeight: Until a weightage field exists, every activity with no weightage value counts as 1 (the S-curve is then by activity count)
